name: Salesforce
current: $125/user/mo add-on · Core $195 / Advanced $395 / Max $550 per user/mo
blurb: Salesforce has restructured how it sells AI three times in about a year: Einstein add-ons became a $125/user/month Agentforce add-on, packaging then expanded to Flex Credits, conversations and Agentforce 1 Editions, and in September 2026 Core, Advanced and Max editions appeared. Every change below is verified against Salesforce's own pages.

name: QuickBooks Online
blurb: QuickBooks Online raised Essentials, Plus and Advanced prices at renewals on or after August 1, 2026. Simple Start, Free, Lite and Ledger were excluded.

name: Figma
blurb: Figma replaced per-product billing with unified Full, Dev and Collab seats in March 2025, and removed monthly billing from Organization and Enterprise.

name: Kit
current: Creator $33/mo annual ($39 monthly) · Pro $66/mo annual ($79 monthly)
blurb: Kit (formerly ConvertKit) retired its old $15/month entry tier in a September 2025 repricing, and its higher tier is mid-rebrand from Creator Pro to Kit Pro.

name: Atlassian
current: Data Center licenses go read-only Mar 28, 2029
blurb: Atlassian is retiring Data Center on a phased timeline through 2029 and steering customers to Cloud. The ~28% average Cloud cost increase is third-party analysis, not an Atlassian figure.
